messages:
acme-integration: Hi — starting ~10:57 PDT we saw a large number of 504s from /v1/generate for our batch pipeline in us-west. Multiple customers report duplicate token billing. Example trace: trace=usw-9f2a-7aa3. Using redwood-sdk@0.8 with default retries. Any known issues?

alex: Thanks for the heads up. Can you paste one full request/response pair (headers + body) and the SDK config? Also: approx p95 latency and whether this is steady or a short burst.

acme-integration: Pasting repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_redacted" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"...","batch_size":8,"timeout_ms":45000}' \
  https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Headers show `Connection: keep-alive`. SDK snippet: `Client(retries=None)` (we didn't override backoff). p95 spiked to ~6s then 504s; lasted ~15min.

alex: Ok — sounds like client retry concurrency + edge backpressure. I'm throttling this tenant temporarily to 10r/s and enabling fallback to rwd-small for lower latency. Maya, can you triage runtime/edge queues? :investigating:

maya: Looking at ingress metrics — queue depth for that tenant jumped and the autoscaler didn't catch up because requests were rapidly retried. I also see many upstream FIN/RESET between edge and router; likely keepalive mismatch. Putting initial hypothesis: retry storm -> queue growth -> long-poller timeouts (504).

sam: Poked the runtime logs. There's a repeated pattern: client retries (same idempotency absent) created 3x concurrent pipelines, hitting the K/V cache lock contention for long sequences. Also seen kernel switch thrashing when sequence length variable. Quick repro I've been running (python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="sk_")
for _ in range(50):
    client.generate(model="rwd-large", input="x"*2000, timeout_ms=45000)
```
If SDK doesn't back off, you see inflight climb then 502/504.

alex: Thanks Sam. Immediate mitigation steps we did: 1) tenant throttled at ingress, 2) enabled per-tenant circuit-breaker to reject after queue > 200, 3) temporary model-fallback. Customer-facing note going out now.

taylor: I've messaged the customer (support ticket #4521) with an ETA: we implemented a throttling mitigation and will follow up with root-cause and credits. Asked them to disable aggressive client retries for now.

sam: Suggested SDK change for customer to mitigate: set retries to 2 and exponential backoff, and use idempotency keys for batch jobs. Example config: `client = RedwoodClient(retries={"max_attempts":2, "backoff_factor":0.5})`. Also recommend enabling streaming heartbeats if using long-running streams.

acme-integration: Will patch SDK usage and redeploy in next 30m. Appreciate the temporary throttle. Regarding billing: can you confirm how duplicate token charges occur?

billing-bot: Notified billing ops. Preliminary check: duplicate upstream requests that complete twice (due to client retry + delayed success) can double-count usage in charge logs. We'll put a provisional credit hold while investigations proceed.

maya: For long-term fixes: 1) server-side default circuit breaker per-tenant, 2) adjust edge keepalive and connection reuse settings to match common SDK defaults, 3) change autoscaler target to account for short retry bursts, 4) runtime: reduce K/V cache lock timeouts and prioritize short sequences. I'll file infra tasks.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch deployed to ingress: connection backlog increased to 1024, per-tenant queue-shed threshold lowered, smoothing window enlarged. No downtime.

alex: Summary / next actions: - Support to confirm customer changed SDK retries (taylor) - Billing to issue provisional credit (billing-bot) - Eng to implement infra follow-ups (maya/sam) - We'll monitor tenant metrics for 2h and reopen if issues persist.

taylor: Customer confirmed SDK change and redeploy started at +20m. I'll update ticket with mitigation steps and ask for a follow-up sync tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Placed a provisional $1,200 credit hold to offset suspected double-counting; will finalize after postmortem.

sam: Early RCA: combination of aggressive client retries + edge keepalive mismatch causing reconnection storms -> ingress queue saturation -> KV-cache lock contention -> 504/502 cascade. Proposed long-term: SDK defaults to safe backoff, server-side circuit-breaker and tenant-level reservoir.

alex: Closing Slack thread for now, keeping ticket open until postmortem. If 504s reappear, ping @maya directly. Thanks all.
